# HereFishyFishy

> Free Ontario river fishing conditions app. Tells anglers where to fish today based on live flow data, water temperature, and weather.

## What this site does

HereFishyFishy is a web app for Ontario anglers. It recommends the best river sections to fish on a given day or forecast date, using live gauge data, Open-Meteo weather forecasts, and species-specific seasonal logic. It covers rivers across Southern Ontario including the Credit, Grand, Humber, Rouge, Ganaraska, Duffins, Bronte, Saugeen, Notawasaga, and others.

## Who it's for

Recreational anglers in Southern Ontario targeting Brown Trout, Rainbow Trout, Brook Trout, Steelhead, Chinook Salmon, and Coho Salmon in rivers.

## Key features

- River section recommendations ranked by current conditions
- Live flow data from Water Survey of Canada gauges
- Estimated water temperature from air temp
- Hourly cloud cover with per-period fishing windows (morning, midday, evening)
- Access point information with crowd level and GPS coordinates
- Ontario fishing regulations (FMZ, seasons, limits) per river section
- Technique and gear recommendations by conditions
- Species seasonal status and staging information
- Email alerts for excellent conditions

## Coverage

Southern Ontario rivers. Eastern rivers (Ganaraska, Wilmot, Bowmanville) run 2–3 weeks ahead of western rivers (Credit, Humber, Bronte) in spring. Steelhead spring run gated on Lake Ontario surface temperature (5–10°C band). Chinook run peaks October. Coho peaks November.

## No app download required

Runs in any mobile browser at herefishyfishy.ca. Free, no account required to use.

## Key pages

- https://herefishyfishy.ca/ — Live conditions app (main tool)
- https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers — All covered rivers with species
- https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/salmon-run-timing — When salmon run in Ontario, river-by-river timing table (staging begins July on eastern rivers, late July on the Credit/Humber; runs peak mid-September to mid-October)
- https://herefishyfishy.ca/credit-river/chinook-salmon — Live Credit River Chinook conditions (also: /brown-trout, /rainbow-trout, /brook-trout, /steelhead, /coho-salmon)
- https://herefishyfishy.ca/about — Who built this and how it works
